class.name: Box3DSurfaceGameplayData
class.brief_description: Base class for project-defined surface gameplay data.
class.description:
[Box3DSurfaceGameplayData] carries no data of its own and is never read by the physics engine. It exists so a project can declare its own per-surface gameplay fields as a real type, and so the editor can filter to that type instead of offering every [Resource] class. Declare a subclass in the project, then select it in [b]Project Settings > Physics > Gameplay Data Class[/b]. New surface materials are created with an instance of it, and every [member Box3DSurfaceMaterial.gameplay] slot is limited to it: [codeblock] # res://surface_gameplay_data.gd class_name SurfaceGameplayData extends Box3DSurfaceGameplayData
@export_range(0.0, 1.0) var penetration := 0.0 @export var footsteps: AudioStreamRandomizer [/codeblock] The class is stored by name in the [code]physics/box3d/surface_gameplay_data[/code] project setting, so renaming the class or removing its [code]class_name[/code] leaves the setting dangling; the Physics tab flags this rather than silently treating it as unset.
